home.heroTitle: From your diploma to <accent>everything you can become</accent>, everywhere.
home.heroSubtitle: AkJol is an education router: describe where you stand today, and AkJol maps every study path open to you worldwide — with the conditions, the probabilities, and exactly how to apply.
home.howStep1Body: Country, current diploma, languages, constraints. 2 minutes — you can change anything later.
home.howStep2Body: Every program is marked open, closed, or open-with-a-step. No hidden promises.
home.howStep3Body: Save paths, compare schools, prepare your applications. Everything is exportable.
home.countriesSubtitle: Click a flag to see the programs available in that country.
home.personasSubtitle: Two ready-made profiles to explore the full experience in one click.
home.personasLeaBody: Wants to know what's next after her BTS. AkJol shows her Licence pro, engineering school via ATS, master via L3, work-study bachelor — with conditions and probabilities.
home.personasLanaBody: Wants medicine or engineering abroad. AkJol computes FR/UK/SG corridors, visa, total cost and scholarships (Eiffel, Chevening, Erasmus Mundus).
home.personasOverwriteConfirm: This will replace your current passport with the test profile. Continue?
home.numbersFreeLabel: no ads, no freemium, no data resale
home.numbersFreeSource: No ads, no freemium, no data resale
home.trustOpenSourceBody: Every line of AkJol is public. You can read it, fork it, challenge it.
home.trustMethodologyBody: Every probability follows a documented formula. The source of every number is shown.
home.trustNoAdsBody: No school pays to be promoted. Rankings only reflect your profile.
home.trustGdprBody: Your data stays local by default. Export and deletion are one click away.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Browse every program and every institution — no simulation, no pressure. The filter works both ways: pick a program to see schools that offer it, or pick a school to see its programs.
catalog.matchHint: “Match with your profile” badges appear when the program is open for your current passport.
catalog.createPassportHint: Create your passport to see matches →
catalog.mapLegend: Clustered by city · click to open a school · size = number of programs · green = match with your profile

jobs.title: Which job are you aiming for?
jobs.subtitle: {n} jobs · click to see the routes from your current passport.
jobs.searchPlaceholder: Search a job… (e.g. Doctor, Data, Pentester)
jobs.methodNote: Method. Median salaries are sourced (INSEE DADS, ONS UK, BLS US). The “automation risk” is an indicative estimate based on Frey-Osborne 2017 (not a prediction). See methodology.
jobs.dailyTasks: What you do day to day
jobs.dailyTasksNote: Indicative list — varies with seniority, sector, employer.
jobs.buildPassportHint: Build your passport to see routes from your current starting point.
jobs.noRoutes: No route found within 5 steps from your passport. The job likely requires a diploma you don't have yet (or a path not covered in the current database).
jobs.noProgramsForJob: No program in the current database explicitly lists {job} as an outcome.
jobs.sourcesNote: Sources. Salaries: INSEE DADS / ONS / BLS. Automation risk: Frey-Osborne 2017 estimate. Tasks: ROME (Pôle emploi). Details on /methodology.
jobs.trajectorySummary: {flags} {steps, plural, =1 {1 step} other {# steps}} · {years, plural, =1 {1 year} other {# years}} · {cost} · prob {pct}%

program.onlyHere: For now, AkJol only lists {school} for this program. Other institutions probably offer it in real life — we're working on adding them.
program.alsoTaughtCount: {count, plural, =1 {1 other institution listed in AkJol teaches the same program} other {# other institutions listed in AkJol teach the same program}}. Compare before applying — fees, city, duration, admission rate can differ.
program.continueTooltip: Push this diploma onto the virtual journey and explore what's next
program.epistemicBody: The displayed probability is computed from your passport (or current virtual journey) and the AkJol database — it's always shown with its confidence interval and sample size. No promise.
program.forYouSection: For you · tailored to your passport

school.addressUnknown: Address not listed — see the institution's official page
school.formationsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No programs listed} =1 {1 program listed} other {# programs listed}}
school.openForProfile: {count, plural, =0 {0 programs open} =1 {1 program open} other {# programs open}} for your profile
